reason: Every measurement checks out on tasks.dense at 1920x1000: To Do body runs 195-775 with 5 of 10 cards fully visible, 0 partially visible (no peek), and 'Add here' at 779; In Progress hides 2 of 7, Done 3 of 9 — 10 of 32 in all. The tray::after fold computes to rgba(17,17,17,0.08), the identical value the card border is drawn in, mask-image is none and the scrollbar gutter is 0. A full text scan of [data-app="tasks"] finds no element containing 'more', 'below', 'hidden' or 'of 10', and .trayBody carries no aria-label, so neither a sighted nor a screen-reader user is told anything — the only cue is the lane total 630px up at 11px/400/62% ink, which has to be reconciled by counting and subtracting.
sharpenedFix: Two corrections to the proposal. (1) Fix the cue as well as the word: a hairline drawn in the same --line value as every card border cannot read as a cue whatever it says beside it — step the fold to --ink-4, the value the card's own open ring already uses, so it is a different line from the thirty it sits among. (2) Do not add a button. Three lanes gaining a second tab stop in their foot, and 'Add here' pushed a row further down, costs more than it buys; render the residue as quiet non-interactive text in the trayAdd row's own line ('5 more below', 13px/400/62% ink, right-aligned) and let the existing lane scroller and card rover do the moving. Derive the number as lane count minus fully-visible cards from the same accessor the head count uses, and assert it in interaction-check.mjs at 1920 and 1440.
